_comment: Tool/MCP registry for SystemOne tool relevance ranking (ranked_tools). kind=tool: ZCode CLI built-in tools (grounded from apps/zcode-cli/packages/contracts/src/tools in the ZCode repo). kind=mcp: Ryan's live MCP servers (Mac mini inventory, Sep 2026). Descriptions are written contrastively (what each tool FAILS at) so the zero-shot relevance head discriminates on capability boundaries. This is config, not code: edit freely, no release needed beyond a shim restart.

tools.description: Read file contents from the workspace. Plain text, code, configs. FAILS at web pages, images, PDFs (see read-pdf), and anything not on disk.
Create new files or overwrite existing ones in the workspace. FAILS at partial edits (see edit) and at anything outside the workspace.
Surgical string replacement inside an existing file. FAILS at creating files from scratch and at large restructures (see apply-patch).
Apply multi-hunk patches and larger code restructures. FAILS at single small edits (see edit) and at non-code files.
Run shell commands: builds, tests, git, scripts, system inspection. FAILS at interactive programs and at anything needing a GUI.
Search file contents by regex across the workspace. FAILS at semantic code search and at web content.
Find files by name pattern (e.g. **/*.ts). FAILS at content search (see grep).
Fetch a URL and extract its text content. FAILS at JavaScript-heavy pages, logins, and interactive sites (see browserclaw).
Web search by query, returns snippets and links. FAILS at deep research synthesis and at logged-in content.
Maintain a task plan with checkboxes across a multi-step job. FAILS at anything except plan bookkeeping.
Spawn a subagent for a self-contained piece of work. FAILS at quick single-step jobs (overhead) and at browser work.
Launch a specialized agent profile with its own tools. FAILS at simple questions answerable inline.
Ask Ryan a clarifying question mid-task. FAILS when the answer is knowable without asking — asking is the failure mode.
Invoke a workspace skill playbook (repeatable browser/research workflows). FAILS at one-off tasks with no playbook.
Edit Jupyter notebook cells. FAILS at plain source files (see edit).
Extract text from PDF documents. FAILS at scanned/image PDFs without OCR text.
Evaluate JavaScript snippets in a Node REPL for quick experiments. FAILS at persistent scripts (see bash).

Drive a real Chromium browser: navigate, click, fill forms, read pages, screenshots. Ryan's hardened backend on the Mac mini. FAILS on X's logged-in pages (renderer crashes — use Comet/Chrome there), and never touches his :9869 pinchtab session.
Ryan's grow operation: 30 tools for cannabis plants, breeding log, stages, harvests, sensor data. FAILS at anything not grow-related.
Wireless ADB to Ryan's Pixel 6 (tent phone): shell commands, app interaction, sensor reads via the AC Infinity app. FAILS when the wireless link wedges (phone-side toggle needed).
Grok Build CLI as a research helper: code and web research via xAI. FAILS at local-only work.
Multi-model council deliberation: several models debate and converge on hard judgment calls. FAILS at fast trivial questions (overkill).
MiniMax API tools: chat, research, and media generation via MiniMax models. Ryan's MiniMax Coding Plan is canceled — this is API use, not the plan.
Six-source weather sweep for Huber Heights, OH: NWS alerts/forecast, SPC outlooks, FEMA declarations, news, social (local TV first), WHIO Storm Center 7. FAILS outside weather.
RuneScape game data: prices, guides, hiscores lookups. FAILS at anything outside the game.
Watchdog over Ryan's agent fleet: health checks, crash detection, process supervision. FAILS at general monitoring outside his machines.
macOS desktop control on the Mac mini: GUI clicks, keystrokes, window management. FAILS over plain SSH (needs a GUI session).
MOA advisor personas for structured business/life advice. FAILS at factual lookup.
Apple Calendar and Reminders on the Mac: read and create events, reminders. FAILS at Google Calendar (different skill).
